verse.text: A house is built by wisdom, and it is established by understanding; by knowledge the rooms are filled with every precious and beautiful treasure.

video.title: Proverbs 24: You Must Do The Work Before You Build Your House

reflection: A home isn't built by accident — it's built brick by brick through the daily choices a man makes: how he speaks to his wife, how he handles conflict, how he spends his evenings. Wisdom isn't flashy; it looks like showing up, staying calm, and choosing what's right even when it's harder. Fill your house with that kind of treasure, and it'll outlast anything money could buy.
